aboutMore: second part bc greg says my about me is 'mostly a phone.' i learned drums on a $6 practice pad from a garage sale my dad bought me in 5th grade. i keep it under my bed and play it at 6am before school bc the house is quiet. my dad does cable installs, hes the reason i know rush and that the truck 'doesnt need gas, it needs respect.' my sticks are 5Bs. becca (clarinet section leader) has been trying to get me on the drumline since august. i keep saying no. she keeps counting my lips. im better at drums than i am at anything else. kayla knows that. i think thats why she keeps me.

blog.title: thursday casserole (a transcript) (11 questions)
blog.body: (1) kaylas mom: bryan do you want seconds. me: yes ma'am. (2) her: where do you see yourself in five years. me: drums ma'am. (3) her: do you have a plan b. me: more drums. kaylas dad: (to kayla) pass the salt. (4) her: is the phone charged. me: yes ma'am. its in the truck. (5) her: why is it in the truck. me: thats where it lives. (6) her: what do your parents do. me: dad does cable. mom does books at a flooring place. her: very respectable. (7) her: do you eat breakfast. me: sometimes. her: sometimes is not a meal. (8) her: do you go to church. me: sometimes with josh. (9) her: do you own a jacket. me: (long pause) yes ma'am. (10) her: do you love my daughter. me: (silence) (kayla stopped chewing) (the casserole was very good) yes ma'am. her: well. good. (11) her: did you get my sisters angel. me: yes ma'am. her: she says youre a keeper. she knows the forward. then she wrapped a square in foil w/ my name on it n told me not to eat it in the truck. i ate it in the truck. kayla walked me out n said 'you did fine.' i said 'i said yes ma'am 9 times.' she said 'its 11. i counted.' thats how i know were good.

blog.title: how to count in 7/8 (for people who dont play drums) (for kevin)
blog.body: ok. fractured signal is in 7/8. kevin has a ddr pad and 2 perfect combos and none of that helps w/ 7/8 so i taught him on a pillow in my room. here is the method. a normal beat is 4: one two three four. seven is that, but tripped. the trick is you dont count to 7. you count 2, 2, 3. say it: ONE-two, ONE-two, ONE-two-three. thats seven. then go again. the 3 at the end is the stumble. think of a guy walking down stairs and stepping on the dogs tail on the last step. the dog doesnt mind, hes just there. that's the 3. play it on a pillow till you dont need to think. then play it on a snare. then play it on the pad if u have to. kevin got it in 40 min. then he did a backflip. a different backflip. i want everyone to know i taught this. neil peart would be proud, and also a little confused. my dad says the whole trick is 'dont fight the extra one, just let it in.' he was talking about 7/8. he might not have been.

blog.title: things i do instead of texting (a list) (not a defense)
blog.body: 1. carry in the groceries. every time. nobody has to ask. 2. learn the counts to kaylas kick line so i know when shes tired. in the 3rd quarter its always the 4th count. she doesnt know. i keep time on the bleachers. the band rushes, so it sounds late. its not me. 3. keep everyones birthday on the inside of my kick drum in sharpie. greg, nate, kayla, josh, my mom, the guy who sold me my hi-hats. i dont forget. i just show up w/ a gas station card and say 'happy birthday.' 4. fix greg's pedal spring. 5. leave a large cherry limeade on a porch at 11:15 at night. one time. it counts. 6. keep my sticks in my back pocket in case someone needs a tap on the table. i know its not texting. texting is better. im working on it. i have my phone in my pocket right now. its ON. that is a first. i have 4 texts from kayla and im reading them one at a time. like a bomb. i'll answer all 4. in order.

blog.title: the truck (a list of rules from my dad)
blog.body: its my dads old ranger. 200,000 miles, no air, a rush cd that doesnt eject. here r the rules. 1. never lend it to greg. (i have lent it to greg.) 2. if the tank is under a quarter, fill it. 3. the check engine light is a suggestion. 4. the kit goes in the bed, not the cab. 5. return it w/ the radio on the same station. there is only one station. its the cd. so the truck plays 'tom sawyer' on a loop and i know every fill. thats how i learned to play, honestly. my dad never said 'good job.' he said 'that fill was early.' that is the highest compliment in my house. last week my dad asked if the truck has a name. i said no. he said 'it does. its neil.' i have been driving a truck named neil for 2 years and nobody told me. he also said the cd was in there when he got it and its not his to eject. i think thats about more than the cd. neil is in the driveway. neil is a good truck.
